d1._meaning: D1 declares no scoring objective; its per-item mean of the KL is the historical, KL-only path and its identities are untouched

aggregation_difference_from_d1.depth: none: per item over T_x, items averaged equally within a sub-type, then sub-type and domain -- D1's DEPTH rule
aggregation_difference_from_d1.state_evaluation: none since revision 3: within a sub-type items are weighted by T_x (the integrand pooled over the sub-type's scored positions, divided by their count) and each critical class is pooled over items -- D1's state-KL weighting. The per-item value keeps the fixed 1/T_x. state.objective.raw_kl.* is the raw KL under this same aggregation and equals D1's state.teacher_kl.* and state.critical_token_kl

confidence_signals.d2: the FROZEN ORIGINAL TEACHER's full-vocabulary confidence, a weight on the root-reference KL
confidence_signals.d3: the candidate STUDENT's own Top-200 confidence, a reward beside the parent-reference KL

d2.formula: L_D2(x) = (1/T_x) sum_{t in T_x} c_T(t) KL(p_T || q_C)_t, minimized; c_T(t) = 1 - H_T(t)/log|V|, H_T the frozen original teacher's full-vocabulary Shannon entropy (float32, chunked), KL on the Top-200 + tail support against the ROOT for every consumer

motivation.title: teacher-certainty-weighted fidelity
motivation.premise: Where the frozen original teacher is certain -- low full-vocabulary entropy -- its next-token distribution encodes a determinate fact, step or format the compressed student should keep. Where it is uncertain, several continuations are acceptable and the KL to its spread-out distribution is a weaker signal of structural damage.
motivation.consequence: Under the same capacity limit, a structure that preserves the teacher's distribution at the teacher's certain positions may keep more of what matters for reasoning than one that minimizes the KL uniformly over every scored position.
motivation.question: Does weighting the root-reference KL, and the structural operators' activation statistics, by the frozen teacher's confidence select an initialization that recovers more autonomous task correctness than the standing incumbent B?
motivation.role_of_confidence: c_T is a property of the frozen teacher at the calibration and evaluation positions. No candidate can change it, so a candidate cannot lower the objective by becoming confident. It is a PROXY for where fidelity matters; its value is decided by behavioural evidence after recovery, never assumed

d2.hypothesis: Positions at which the frozen teacher is certain carry the information a small student most needs to preserve; spending the structural selection's fidelity budget there, rather than uniformly, selects initializations that recover more autonomous task correctness. This does NOT assume the teacher's uncertain positions are unimportant -- it tests whether down-weighting their KL, and their weight in the activation statistics, helps or hurts.

changes.change: DEPTH's KL reference: the intact PARENT -> the frozen original teacher (the lineage ROOT)
changes.d2: KL(root || parent with S bypassed), the root's Top-200 + tail sketch read from the root reference store built once per calibration mixture
changes.where_it_is_inactive: at the search root the parent IS the root, so the two references coincide; the change acts on DEPTH expansions of a compressed parent

changes.d2: c_T multiplies the KL in DEPTH, state evaluation and the ranked metrics, and the activation statistics of the FFN, residual-WIDTH and ATTENTION operators

declared_changes.not_one_variable: D2 differs from D1 by both changes together. No claim attributes a D1-vs-D2 difference to the weighting alone. Descriptive separation only: every DEPTH round-0 candidate also records its parent-reference KL, and every candidate and state records the UNWEIGHTED root KL

acts_directly_on: DEPTH operator-local candidate evaluation: c_T-weighted root KL

FFN, residual WIDTH and ATTENTION activation statistics: every accumulator -- residual sum and second moment, FFN sum|a| and sum a^2, per-head attention-output second moment -- weighted by c_T, over a sum-of-weights denominator
global state evaluation of every child (reference: the teacher)

denominators.kl_objective: the fixed 1/T_x over the item's scored positions; never the sum of weights
denominators.activation_statistics: sum_t w_t, with w_t = policy token weight x c_T(t); a zero-weight position is dropped like padding

scope.token_alignment: token j carries c_T of prediction j -- the logits its own state produces -- and the item's last token, which feeds no prediction inside the item, carries zero; the supervised-target policy's token weights are its prediction weights with that same trailing zero
not_weighted: the scored-position set, which stays the binary supervised-target policy
operators outside D1's frozen four (none is in the search space)

narrow_scope_comparison.difference: FFN, WIDTH and ATTENTION keep D1's target-aware statistics; their configs then declare no objective and their selections are D1's for the same parent
narrow_scope_comparison.status: DOCUMENTED FOR COMPARISON ONLY; not wired, not frozen

full_scope_review.implemented: aadistill core: ActivePositions token multipliers, the collectors' token_weights path (process / process_batch, per-item and packed), the weighted denominators residual_weight / attn_token_weight, and a statistics cache key that carries the weighting store's identity so weighted and unweighted passes never share an entry
risks: LOW DYNAMIC RANGE: normalised by log|V| (~11.9 nats at a 151,936 vocabulary), c_T sits near 1 wherever the teacher's entropy is a few nats, so the weighting may change the statistics and the ranking only modestly. Measured by the teacher-confidence validity check BEFORE the search; never re-defined post hoc
WIDTH's projection is trace-normalised per collection point, so a near-uniform weighting cancels; the weighting acts through its non-uniformity only
teacher-UNCERTAIN positions -- branch points in a reasoning chain -- lose weight in the structure selection as well as in the KL; whether that helps is the hypothesis, not an assumption
the reduced effective sample size of the weighted statistics (reported as ESS by the validity check)
full_scope_review.blockers: none found; the full scope is frozen

fixed: no dynamic weight sum in the KL objective
no threshold, exponent or hard mask on c_T
diagnostics_recorded: the unweighted root (teacher) KL, beside the weighted objective, for every DEPTH candidate and every state (state.objective.raw_kl.*)
the PARENT-reference KL of every DEPTH round-0 candidate (op-local parent_kl; one parent reference pass per DEPTH expansion, round 0 only -- a documented, limited scope)
reference entropy, reference confidence and weight quantiles and histograms; reference tail mass
D1's KL metrics, unchanged, beside them
the root reference store's identity, content digest and confidence distribution (weight sum, mean, ESS)

where_it_applies.depth.causal_kl_greedy_v1: OPERATOR-LOCAL: the candidate is the parent with S bypassed; its KL against the ROOT's stored sketch, weighted by the root's stored confidence
where_it_applies.ffn / residual_width / attention activat: FULL SCOPE: their activation statistics are weighted by the frozen teacher's confidence, which needs no candidate; their configs declare the objective and their state ids fork from D1's
where_it_applies.state evaluation: every child, against the original teacher, weighted by the teacher's own confidence

d2.degeneracy_watch: the weight is the frozen teacher's, so no candidate can lower the objective by becoming confident; a candidate CAN be worse at the teacher's uncertain positions at a discount. The unweighted root KL is recorded on every candidate and state, and a low D2 objective is never read as higher fidelity. High raw KL is a registered DIAGNOSTIC FLAG (diagnostic_threshold_rule), never an elimination criterion and never a manual intervention

may_not_claim: that D2 differs from D1 by one variable: it declares two changes, the DEPTH reference (parent -> root) and the teacher-confidence weighting (d2.declared_changes)
that a lower D2 objective means the student is closer to the teacher: it down-weights the teacher's uncertain positions by construction
that the teacher's confident positions are the ones that matter for reasoning, without behavioural evidence after recovery
that the full-scope weighting changed an FFN, WIDTH or ATTENTION selection, unless a measured selection overlap shows it
that D2 reads any student confidence: its weight is the frozen teacher's and no candidate can move it

d2.validity_checks_before_search: stages.d_series.teacher_confidence: distribution, thinking vs answer, domain and subtype, token types, relation to teacher token probability and to KL, weighted contributions, weight sum, mean, ESS and risks -- run on the root reference store before the formal search; their results never change a definition

engineering_measurements_only: reference calibration stage L (refcal_20261013_170714): DEPTH one-round and state-evaluation overhead, scored_v1 equivalence

d2_superseded.formula: L(x) = (1/T_x) sum_{t in T_x} (1 - c_t) KL_t, c_t the candidate student's own Top-200 confidence

d3.formula: L(x) = (1/T_x) sum_{t in T_x} [KL_t - lambda c_t], minimized (S = -L maximized); c_t = 1 - H^(200)_C(t)/log 200, the candidate student's own Top-200 conditional entropy; KL against the parent in DEPTH and the teacher in state evaluation

motivation.title: capacity-aware student reasoning
motivation.premise: The teacher (Qwen3-4B-Thinking) and the ~0.6B student differ in capacity, expressiveness and learning ability. The student need not, and may not be able to, reproduce the teacher's reasoning distribution; on some tasks it may reach the same correct answer by a shorter, simpler or entirely different trajectory.
motivation.consequence: A large teacher token-level KL does not by itself mean worse student reasoning. KL-based compression selection may over-reward structures that imitate the teacher's distribution and under-rate structures that preserve the student's own effective way of reasoning.
motivation.question: Which structural initialization, under the capacity limit, best lets the student keep and recover its own effective reasoning ability?
motivation.role_of_confidence: D3 ONLY: the candidate student's own Top-200 confidence is a CANDIDATE PROXY signal for structure selection, entering as a reward. D2 reads no student confidence (d2.motivation). Its value is decided by independent behavioural evidence, never assumed

acts_directly_on: global state evaluation of every child
does_not_act_on: FFN, residual WIDTH and ATTENTION operator-local selection: they keep D1's target-aware activation statistic unchanged; their children are reached by the objective only through state evaluation and the beam
scope.do_not_claim: that the local rules of all four operators use student confidence
scope.intermediate_vs_final_student: the confidence the search reads belongs to INTERMEDIATE candidates -- the parent with some layers bypassed in DEPTH, partially compressed children in state evaluation -- before any recovery training. It is not the confidence of the final ~0.6B student after recovery, and it is not evidence about that model's capacity adaptation; only the behavioural evaluation after recovery speaks to that

where_it_applies.depth.causal_kl_greedy_v1: OPERATOR-LOCAL, exactly: the candidate is the parent with S bypassed, and its KL against the parent and its own Top-K entropy come from the same forward
where_it_applies.ffn / residual_width / attention activat: NOT operator-local -- no candidate exists until it is made, so there is no candidate KL or confidence to weight; they keep D1's statistic and their state ids do not fork
where_it_applies.state evaluation: every child, against the original teacher; the student is the child itself

diagnostics_recorded: student Top-200 entropy, confidence and Top-K mass
D1's KL metrics, unchanged, beside them

may_not_claim: that the student reasons differently, or better, where it is confident and far from the teacher, without rollout-level evidence linking those positions to correct completions
that the local selection rules of all four operators use student confidence (only DEPTH's does; see d3.scope)
that confidence read on intermediate search candidates describes the final recovered student's capacity adaptation

d3.hypothesis: The student's own predictive certainty may carry structural-selection value independent of the teacher KL: even where its token distribution differs from the teacher's, a student that is certain of its own distribution earns a separate confidence reward. Whether that signal is useful is decided by task correctness after recovery training, not by the reward.

lambda_rule.statistic: per-item means over each item's scored positions (1/T_x)
lambda_rule.pooling: every UNIQUE item of the three item sets once, unweighted, unique by content identity (sha256 of the token ids). The three sets hold 209 draws but 147 unique items: reasoning_heavy@v2's 62 draws are 51 unique items, all of them also in domain_balanced@v1, which sampled with replacement from the same pool. Counting a repeated draw twice would weight it twice. The with-duplicates value and each set alone are reported as sensitivity, never chosen
lambda_rule.when: ONCE, BEFORE D2's formal search -- not before D3 -- and never revised by any D2 or D3 search or behavioural result

reference.student_model: the standing incumbent B, artifact 53e30566c5f795f1870d76c1fa6a970ddc507fa5459047f3010ffab8aa890342, rebuilt by stages.phase_c2.baseline.frozen_baseline_spec
reference.entropy: the student's own Top-200 conditional entropy

lambda_rule.why_this_scale: lambda converts confidence into KL units. Equating the two components' between-item spread on a reference pair means neither dominates the ranking by scale alone: one inter-quartile range of confidence is worth one inter-quartile range of KL. The IQR rather than the SD because per-item KL is heavy-tailed and the SD would let a few items set the trade-off.
lambda_rule.why_this_reference: a pair NO D-series search produced: the teacher every search starts from and the incumbent every candidate is compared with, at the geometry every search ends at. Measured before D2's search starts and never revised: a lambda chosen after seeing D2 or D3 search or behavioural results would be a selection on outcomes.

diagnostic_threshold_rule.source: the same B-vs-teacher reference calibration as lambda, over the scored positions of the 147 unique items, measured before D2's formal search

thresholds.high_kl: p90 of per-position Top-200 + tail KL (teacher || B)
thresholds.high_confidence: p90 of B's per-position Top-200 confidence
thresholds.low_topk_mass: p10 of B's per-position Top-200 mass

flags.high_confidence_high_kl: confident AND far from the teacher: alternative reasoning or overconfidence, told apart only by correctness
flags.high_confidence_low_topk_mass: a confident Top-200 that holds little of the student's real probability
flags.high_raw_kl: raw KL at or above high_kl, recorded, never acted on

application.depth_candidates_and_states: from the recorded joint histograms; a 'high' threshold is applied at the first grid edge at or above it and a 'low' one at the last edge at or below it, so a flag never counts a position the exact threshold would not

never: enters a score, ranking, pruning or retention
triggers a manual intervention in a running search
is set or revised after D2/D3 candidate results exist

aggregation_control.issue: revision 2 averaged state-evaluation items EQUALLY, where D1's KL-only state metrics weight items by scored positions within a sub-type and pool critical classes over items. That changed length weighting as well as the integrand, so a D1-vs-D2 ranking change could not be attributed to confidence
aggregation_control.resolution: each consumer keeps its KL-only path's weighting (objective identity field `aggregation`, kl_path_weighting_per_consumer/v2): DEPTH averages items equally, as D1's DEPTH did; state evaluation weights items by T_x and pools critical classes. The per-item formula keeps the fixed 1/T_x and never divides by a sum of confidence weights
aggregation_control.built_in_kl_only_control: every objective evaluation also reports state.objective.raw_kl.* -- the raw KL aggregated exactly as the objective is -- which equals D1's state.teacher_kl.* and state.critical_token_kl in the same evaluation (tested to 1e-6). Rankings by raw_kl and by the objective on the same states isolate the effect of the integrand

rollout_rescoring_integration.token_ids: use the generation engine's exact ids, kept by the read-only sidecar wrapper scripts/shared/evaluation/uncapped_eval_token_ids.py. It runs the UNCHANGED in-tree generator (same argv, interpreter and environment) with a hook on the one post-wave decode per record, after the engine loop, so the generation source set, the generation fingerprint and the shared protocol's evaluation identity are the plain run's -- tested on the real generator with a stub engine: identical records, summaries and reconstructed fingerprint. The hook installs only when the generator's source digest equals the protocol's; every row is verified against its record (id count, prompt count, decoded-text sha256, EOS vs stop_reason) and the sidecar header says whether the stratum is exact. A record with no exact row is rescored from retokenized text, ids_source=retokenized_text, labelled approximate per sample. Recording ids inside the generator itself remains a VERSIONED decision (d_series_shared_eval v2), not taken

token_ids_identity.changes: only the behavioural driver's own executable closure, because its argv names the wrapper -- correct for reproducibility, and not part of the generation identity
token_ids_identity.not_in_generation_source_set: the wrapper is deliberately NOT added to source_sets.json generation.files: adding it would move the source digest it exists to preserve
token_ids_identity.residual: engine scheduling is timing-dependent in the plain run too; the wrapper adds no work inside the engine loop, so it changes no code path the tokens depend on, but token equality with a counterfactual plain run cannot be proven on a non-batch-invariant engine

alignment_evidence: count and decoded-text match with the record
untouched: the shared protocol's scoring contract and endpoint
rollout_rescoring_integration.checkpoint_release: only after the diagnostic evidence is persisted durably, when a consumer exists
rollout_rescoring_integration.failure_isolation: a rescoring failure is recorded per sample and never alters or blocks a completed per-sample score (rollout_rescoring.rescore_unit)
rollout_rescoring_integration.cost: MEASURE before pricing: the reference calibration session times the rescoring on the real teacher and B over sequences of D1's measured lengths; the behavioural ceiling includes it only after that measurement. The 3-5 min/probe figure is an estimate, not a bound
rollout_rescoring_integration.historical_units: no logits, confidence or student-side quantity is computed or estimated for B or q2

independence: D3's definition, K and lambda rule are fixed in this record before D2 runs; no D2 behavioural or search result may adjust them

measurement_distinctions.student_entropy_on_teacher_native_prefix: what D3's search objective uses: the candidate student's own Top-200 conditional entropy on the frozen teacher-native calibration and state-eval sequences. D2 does NOT use it
measurement_distinctions.teacher_entropy_on_teacher_native_prefix: what D2's search objective uses: the FROZEN ORIGINAL TEACHER's full-vocabulary Shannon entropy on the same sequences -- from the root reference store (calibration) and the state evaluator (state suite). Identical for every candidate; D3 does not use it
measurement_distinctions.student_entropy_on_student_rollout_prefi: a behavioural DIAGNOSTIC only: the student's own Top-K entropy at the positions of its own greedy rollout, by scripts/shared/evaluation/rollout_rescoring.py after generation. Never an input to selection in D2 or D3
measurement_distinctions.student_teacher_distribution_fit: the Top-K + tail KL: on teacher-native prefixes in the search -- against the intact PARENT in D1's and D3's DEPTH, against the ROOT teacher in D2's DEPTH, against the teacher in every state evaluation; on the student's own prefixes in the rollout diagnostic, beside the teacher's surprisal of the student's tokens
measurement_distinctions.autonomous_rollout_correctness: the primary behavioural endpoint, correct_overall on the shared protocol, after the frozen recovery recipe. The only quantity a D2/D3 promotion question is decided on

calibration_this_round: the frozen TEACHER-NATIVE calibration profiles, unchanged. Between D1 and D3 the objective is the only variable; D2 declares two (d2.declared_changes). No student-prefix calibration is introduced in D2 or D3

instruments.rollout_profile: scripts/stages/stage-1/families/d_series/rollout_profile.py -- text-level, $0, from secured generations: generated length (engine count), reasoning/answer length, natural termination, degeneration, correctness by reasoning length, and paired same-prompt comparisons
instruments.rollout_rescoring: scripts/shared/evaluation/rollout_rescoring.py -- per position of the student's own rollout: student confidence, student token log-prob, teacher surprisal, KL(teacher || student). Needs the trained checkpoint, so it runs ON THE POD after generation and before the checkpoint is released. Reads generations; changes neither generation nor scoring, so the shared evaluation protocol's identity is untouched. Estimated 3-5 GPU-minutes per probe (~0.95M tokens per probe at D1's measured lengths)

behavioural_diagnostics.historical_units: B's and q2's ten units have decoded text and the engine's token counts, but NO token ids, log-probabilities or logits, and their checkpoints are retired. Their student confidence on their own rollouts is therefore NOT available and must not be estimated or inferred; comparisons with B/q2 are text-level and endpoint-level only. Re-tokenizing their text reproduces the engine's count exactly for 82-85% of samples
behavioural_diagnostics.power_note: D1's units answer ~2-4% of scorable prompts correctly (B: 103 of 2550 on confirmation), and q2 and B are both right on only 29 prompt-seeds there. Any confidence-correctness or quadrant analysis rests on ~100 correct samples per arm and is exploratory
